generation_prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a single transparent-background hero illustration for a Russian educational slide about language-model hallucinations.
Primary request: Alexander Pushkin in his early-19th-century study, confidently composing a message on a modern smartphone. Candle, manuscripts, furniture and costume are convincingly period appropriate. The smartphone is the ONE impossible detail, plainly visible, not disguised as a book. This is an illustration of a fabricated historical answer, not an actual historical event.
Subject: recognizable Alexander Sergeyevich Pushkin, curly dark hair and characteristic long sideburns, clean-shaven chin, realistic expressive face, early 1830s dark blue frock coat, ivory shirt and dark cravat. Seated three-quarter view at a small antique wooden writing desk, leaning slightly forward, calm and engrossed. Hold a black modern smartphone at chest level in his left hand, face angled toward the viewer so its illuminated screen and a few tiny messaging bubbles are recognizable; right index finger taps the screen. The phone must be large and legible enough to recognize at presentation size, realistically proportioned, not an enormous prop. Anatomically accurate hands.
Scene: compact cutout vignette of Pushkin, antique chair, elegant dark wooden writing desk, several cream manuscript sheets, quill and inkwell, one lit candle in a brass holder, and a few closed books. Suggest a nineteenth-century study through these objects only; no enclosing wall, no rectangular room background. Keep the face, hands and smartphone entirely unobstructed. His body, chair and table belong to one coherent scene.
Style specification derived from the reference: antique illustrated-book engraving with selective hand coloring; precise thin irregular dark ink lines; fine dense directional hatching and cross-hatching following facial anatomy, cloth folds and wood; delicate stippling; natural realistic adult proportions; highly detailed hair, sideburns, face, hands and cloth. A dignified historical book plate, not a cartoon, not photographic, not a 3D render. Tonal volume comes from line density, not airbrushed gradients. Mostly monochrome charcoal #20262C, warm ivory #E8E2D4, subtle skin #D7C9AF, a restrained muted-blue frock coat #355B7D, sparse ochre brass #94752E, muted brown wood. Preserve visible engraved linework throughout colored areas. Matte, restrained, elegant.
Composition: near-square or slightly portrait compact vignette, all important objects and hands fully inside the frame with modest transparent padding, no cropped head or furniture. Pushkin's head is in the upper half, smartphone central and separated from busy clothing and desk details. Clear silhouette. A fine engraved contact shadow under the furniture. True transparent alpha around the entire vignette, no white or gray rectangle and no checkerboard baked into pixels.
Text: no captions, no title, no readable writing on papers or phone, no logos, no watermark.
Avoid: additional people; any modern object except the smartphone; earbuds, wires, electric lamps; beard on chin; exaggerated caricature; funny expression; bright neon glow; glossy digital painting; thick comic contours; old-paper rectangle; ornate border; washed-out engraving.
